title: Supabase button
description: A medium-weight button: a deep green fill with a faint dark edge, a white fill with a hairline border, or a bare ghost. 38px with 6px corners for heroes, a compact 26px for headers, or a round pill chip. Hover darkens the green or washes the white over 200ms with a soft ease-out.
notes: renders a link when href is set, a button otherwise
icons passed as children are sized to 14px
name: supabase-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: green fill · outline: white fill with a hairline border · ghost: no fill until hover

props.name: size
props.description: md: 38px tall, 14px label (hero, closing band) · sm: 26px tall, 12px label (header, footer)

props.name: pill
props.description: fully round ends (the "read docs" chip, tabs) instead of 6px corners

props.name: type
props.description: button type when it renders a button

props.name: onClick
props.description: click handler when it renders a button
